onboarding.documentTitle: Pay any spaza from any wallet
onboarding.body: Take payments with just a QR code. No card machine, very little data, and it keeps working when the signal drops.

setup.title: Set up your shop
setup.walletHint: It starts with $ or https://. Find it in your wallet app.
setup.nameHint: Customers see this when they pay.

poster.title: Your QR poster
poster.hint: Print it on A5 and put it where customers can scan it.

connect.title: Connecting your shop
connect.failed: This link didn't work. Set up the shop again or ask for a new link.

pay.subtitle: Pay with any wallet
pay.walletHint: Saved on this phone for next time.

notFound.title: Shop not found
notFound.description: Check the QR code, or ask the shop for their link.

quote.title: Confirm payment
quote.includes: Includes all fees and the exchange rate.

receipt.title: Payment

waiting.title: Waiting for approval
waiting.description: Approve the payment in your wallet to finish.

receipt.callbackError: We couldn't confirm your approval yet. Check your wallet before trying again.

empty.title: No payments yet
empty.description: Payments appear here the moment they land, and your phone can read them out.

setUp.title: No shop on this phone yet
setUp.description: Setting up takes under two minutes: your wallet address and a shop name.

voice.label: Read payments out loud
voice.unsupported: This phone can't read out loud.

unauthorized.title: This phone is signed out of the shop
unauthorized.description: Open your shop's link again, or set up the shop again.

failures.consent_declined: The payment was declined in the wallet. No money was taken.
failures.consent_invalid: The approval couldn't be verified, so no money was taken.
failures.consent_timeout: The payment wasn't approved in time. No money was taken.
failures.quote_expired: The price expired before the payment was approved. Please try again.
failures.insufficient_funds: The wallet doesn't have enough money for this payment.
failures.grant_limit: The payment is more than the wallet approved.
failures.payment_failed: The payment failed. No money was taken.
failures.timeout: The money is taking long to arrive. Check the wallet before paying again.

empty.title: No open tabs
empty.description: Open a tab at your local spaza once, then pay with a tap, even when there's no signal.

offline.banner: You're offline. AnyPay keeps working and syncs when you're back.

error.description: Reload the page to try again.

walletAddress.format: Wallet addresses start with $ or https://

api.wallet_host_not_allowed: AnyPay can't use wallets from that provider yet.
